_comment: Copy to cellgate.config.json and fill in your CellGate login. Keep that file private (chmod 600): it holds your password.
_assumeOpenSeconds: How long the gate keeps reporting open after you trigger it, for a unit with no position sensor wired to its status input. 0 turns it off and such a gate reads Unknown. Ignored where the sensor does report - a measured state always wins.
_doorbell: Publish a HomeKit doorbell that rings (a 'Front gate' notification on every phone) when someone is at the gate. Set false to turn it off.
_doorbellRingEvents: Which activity-log entries ring it, matched as case-insensitive substrings of the entry's description. The default camera snapshot fires once per visit and not when you open the gate remotely. If your gate logs a distinct call-button entry, add its text here.
